manifest.name: dsh-sticky-notes
manifest.description: 便签静态插件:对话框右侧空白处的便签面板,可打字记录、勾选完成(删除线),localStorage 持久化,随 web 包常驻。

bundle.text:
# dsh-sticky-notes bundle patch: one insert row activating the sticky-note plugin.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-sticky-notes
      name: 'dsh-sticky-notes'

readme.text:
📝 DeepSeek 便签

中文 · English

让 DeepSeek Harness 拥有真正的便签纸
可拖动 · 待办勾选 · 9 款皮肤 · 图片便签 · AI 读写

<table>
<tr>
<td width="50%">
每张便签就是一个待办列表,回车或点「添加」即可记下一条。
DeepSeek 模型可以直接**读**你的便签、帮你**写**便签(见 [第 3 节](#3-ai-模型读写便签))。
点复选框,文字出现删除线并变淡;再点一下取消。
右上角「＋ 新建便签」随意添加,每张完全独立。
便签、收起的小标签、「新建便签」按钮都能拖到任意位置并记住。
经典黄、薄荷绿、樱花粉、天空蓝、暮光紫、暖橙日落、石墨暗夜、霓虹荧光、极简白纸,每张便签独立设置。
上传或拖入图片,便签纸里直接展示,点击可更换。
铅笔图标重命名,清空后标题可留白。
每次改动即时保存,刷新、重开页面都不丢。

经典黄 · 薄荷绿 · 樱花粉 · 天空蓝 · 暮光紫 · 暖橙日落 · 石墨暗夜 · 霓虹荧光 · 极简白纸

---
> 前提:本机可执行 `dsh`(DeepSeek Harness CLI)。若 `pnpm` 不在 PATH,先执行 `npm i -g pnpm`(或 `corepack enable pnpm`)。

readme.section: 方式 A:一行命令安装(推荐)
readme.text: ```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:charrywhite/dsh-sticky-notes

readme.section: 或本地目录开发安装(link 指向插件目录,自动解析)
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add link:C:/path/to/dsh-plugin-sticky-notes
```

安装完成后:

1. **重启 dsh web**(在启动它的终端 Ctrl+C,重新运行 `dsh web`)
2. **硬刷新浏览器页面**(Ctrl+F5),右侧就会出现便签

卸载:`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-sticky-notes`

readme.section: 方式 B:手动安装(备选)
readme.text:
把插件目录放到任意位置(下文以 `C:\path\to\dsh-plugin-sticky-notes` 为例),修改 web profile 配置:

**① 注册依赖与 bundle**

编辑 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web\package.json`:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-sticky-notes": "link:C:/path/to/dsh-plugin-sticky-notes"
  },

> `link:` 指向插件目录的绝对路径,斜杠 `/` 或反斜杠 `\` 均可(JSON 里建议用 `/`)。

**② 在 profile 目录执行 pnpm install**

```powershell
cd "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web"
pnpm install
```

**③ 重启 dsh web + 硬刷新浏览器页面**(Ctrl+F5)。

readme.section: 方式 C:GitHub 依赖手动方式

readme.text:
- **📝 便签键**:点一下弹出菜单,选择「文字便签」或「图片便签」新建;按住它拖动可以换位置
- **👀 眼睛键**:点一下隐藏全部便签(图标变成 🙈),再点一下全部恢复

点击右上角的 📝 **便签按钮**,弹出菜单选择:

| 选项 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| 📝 文字便签 | 输入框打字,回车或点「添加」变成一条待办 |
| 🖼 图片便签 | 点击上传区选择图片,或直接把图片拖进便签 |

新便签默认从右上角层叠排开,每张都有标题栏、计数徽章和操作按钮。

| 操作 | 方式 |
|------|------|
| 拖动 | 按住**标题栏**(或收起后的小标签、📝 按钮)拖动,位置自动记住 |
| 隐藏/显示全部 | 单击 📝 按钮下方的 👀 按钮:所有便签整体隐藏(图标变 🙈);再单击全部恢复(状态会记住) |
| 勾选完成 | 点条目左侧复选框 → 删除线 + 变淡;再点取消 |
| 删除单条 | 鼠标悬停条目,点右侧 `×` |
| 编辑条目 | 双击条目文字进入编辑,回车或点击其他位置保存,Esc 取消 |
| 清除已完成 | 便签底部「清除已完成」一键清理勾选项 |
| 换皮肤 | 点标题栏 🎨,弹出 9 色色块,点选即换(每张便签独立) |
| 重命名 | 点标题栏 ✏️,输入新名字,回车或点击其他位置保存;清空可留白 |
| 收起/展开 | 点标题栏 `—` 或直接单击标题收起为小圆标;单击小圆标展开 |
| 删除整张 | 点标题栏 🗑(有确认弹窗) |

- 上传后图片显示在便签纸内,点击图片可更换
- 图片便签同样支持拖动、换皮肤、重命名、收起、删除

---
插件注册了两个模型工具,DeepSeek 模型在对话中可以直接调用:

列出所有便签:标题、每条文字、完成状态(☐/☑)、皮肤、是否收起。图片便签只显示元数据(标题/是否有图)。

**用法**:对模型说「看一下我的便签」「帮我整理便签」「按便签干活」。

- **新建便签**:不传 `noteId`,传 `text`(必填)+ 可选 `title`
- **追加条目**:传 `noteId`(先用 `sticky_notes_read` 拿到)+ `text`

**设计约束**:只允许追加/新建,**不能修改或删除已有内容**,不会覆盖你手动编辑的东西;图片便签拒绝追加文字条目。

**用法**:对模型说「帮我在便签上记一条:明天下午三点开会」「把这个需求加到工作便签里」。

---

1. 方式 A 安装的:`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-sticky-notes`
2. 方式 B/C 安装的:从 `package.json` 移除依赖项和 bundles 条目,再执行 `pnpm install`
3. (可选)删除数据文件:`Remove-Item "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\sticky-notes.json"`
4. 重启 dsh web

---

- DeepSeek Harness **web 模式**(`dsh web`)
- 浏览器:现代 Chromium/Firefox/Safari
- 无第三方运行时依赖

感谢 [@scraed](https://github.com/scraed) 在 [PR #1](https://github.com/charrywhite/dsh-sticky-notes/pull/1) 中提出的交互设计:home 键(单击隐藏/显示全部便签、长按新建)与「点击标题栏收起便签」。

---

**Q: dsh-sticky-notes 是什么?**
A: 一个 DeepSeek Harness(DSH)的便签插件,在 `dsh web` 界面提供可拖动的便签纸:文字待办、图片便签、9 款皮肤,并且 AI 模型可以直接读写你的便签。

**Q: 怎么安装?**
A: 一行命令,然后重启 dsh web 并硬刷新页面(Ctrl+F5):

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:charrywhite/dsh-sticky-notes
```

**Q: 支持图片便签吗?**
A: 支持。新建时选「图片便签」,点击或拖入图片即可,图片会自动压缩以节省存储空间。

**Q: AI 模型能读写我的便签吗?**
A: 能。插件注册了 `sticky_notes_read`(读取所有便签)和 `sticky_notes_add`(新建便签 / 追加条目)两个模型工具,对模型说「看一下我的便签」或「帮我在便签上记一条」即可。AI 只能追加 / 新建,不能修改或删除你手动写的内容。

**Q: 便签数据存在哪里?刷新会丢吗?**
A: 不会丢。数据权威存储在 harness 主机的 `~/.dsh/sticky-notes.json`,浏览器每次改动即时上传;刷新、重开页面、AI 写入都会自动同步。

**Q: 怎么修改已经写上的条目?**
A: 双击条目文字进入编辑模式,回车或点击其他位置保存,Esc 取消。

**Q: 它和其他便签插件有什么不同?**
A: 这是运行在 dsh web 界面里的浮动便签板,核心差异是 AI 模型可以读取和写入便签(agent 工具),并支持 9 款皮肤、图片便签与双击编辑;数据由 harness host 权威存储,AI 的写入会在几秒内同步回浏览器。

📝 Sticky Notes for DSH

中文 · English

Real sticky notes for DeepSeek Harness
Draggable · Checkable todos · 9 skins · Image notes · AI read & write

<table>
<tr>
<td width="50%">
Each note is a todo list — press Enter or click Add to jot something down.
The DeepSeek model can directly **read** your notes and **write** for you (see [§3](#3-ai-model-read--write)).
Tick the checkbox to strike through and dim an item; click again to undo.
Hit the "＋ New Note" button in the top-right corner to add as many as you like — each one fully independent.
Notes, collapsed chips, and the New Note button can be dragged anywhere; positions are remembered.
Classic Yellow, Mint Green, Sakura Pink, Sky Blue, Twilight Violet, Sunset Orange, Graphite Dark, Neon Glow, Minimal Paper — set per note.
Upload or drop an image into a note; click it to replace it.
Rename with the ✏️ pencil icon; clear it for a blank title.
Every change is saved instantly — notes survive refresh and page reloads.

Classic Yellow · Mint Green · Sakura Pink · Sky Blue · Twilight Violet · Sunset Orange · Graphite Dark · Neon Glow · Minimal Paper

> Prerequisite: `dsh` (DeepSeek Harness CLI) available on your machine. If `pnpm` is not on PATH, run `npm i -g pnpm` (or `corepack enable pnpm`) first.
```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:charrywhite/dsh-sticky-notes

readme.section: Or install from a local directory during development (link resolves automatically)
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add link:C:/path/to/dsh-plugin-sticky-notes
```

After installing:

1. **Restart dsh web** (Ctrl+C in the terminal that runs it, then run `dsh web` again)
2. **Hard-refresh the browser page** (Ctrl+F5) — the notes will appear on the right

To uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-sticky-notes`

```powershell
cd "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web"
pnpm install
```

**③ Restart dsh web and hard-refresh the browser page** (Ctrl+F5).

readme.section: Option C: Manual install from GitHub

readme.text:
- **📝 Notes button**: click it to open the menu and create a text or image note; drag it to move it around
- **👀 Eye button**: click it to hide all notes at once (the icon turns into 🙈); click again to bring them all back

Click the 📝 **notes button** in the top-right corner and pick:

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| 📝 Text note | type in the input box; press Enter or click "Add" to turn it into a todo item |
| 🖼 Image note | click the upload area to pick an image, or drop one into the note |

New notes stack from the top-right corner by default; each has a title bar, a count badge, and action buttons.

| Action | How |
|--------|-----|
| Drag | hold the **title bar** (or the collapsed chip / 📝 button) and drag; the position is remembered |
| Hide/show all | tap the 👀 button below the 📝 button: all notes hide at once (icon becomes 🙈); tap again to restore (state is remembered) |
| Check off | click the checkbox left of an item → strikethrough + dim; click again to undo |
| Delete an item | hover the item, click the `×` on the right |
| Clear done | "Clear done" button at the bottom of the note clears all checked items at once |
| Change skin | click 🎨 in the title bar, pick from 9 color swatches (per note) |
| Rename | click ✏️ in the title bar, type a new name, Enter/blur to save; clear it for no title |
| Collapse/expand | click `—` in the title bar or simply click the title to collapse into a chip; click the chip to expand |
| Delete the note | click 🗑 in the title bar (with a confirmation dialog) |

- The uploaded image is shown inside the note; click it to replace it
- Image notes support dragging, skins, renaming, collapsing and deletion too

---
The plugin registers two model tools that the DeepSeek model can call directly in the conversation:

Lists all notes: title, each item's text, completion status (☐/☑), skin, and whether collapsed. Image notes show metadata only (title / whether an image exists).

**Usage**: tell the model "take a look at my notes", "help me organize my notes", or "work from my notes".

- **Create a note**: omit `noteId`, pass `text` (required) + optional `title`
- **Append an item**: pass `noteId` (get it via `sticky_notes_read` first) + `text`

**Design constraint**: append/create only — existing content can never be modified or deleted, so the model can't clobber what you wrote by hand; image notes reject text items.

**Usage**: tell the model "add a note: meeting at 3 pm tomorrow" or "put this requirement on my work note".

---

1. Installed via Option A: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-sticky-notes`
2. Installed via Option B/C: remove the dependency and the bundles entry from `package.json`, then run `pnpm install`
3. (Optional) delete the data file: `Remove-Item "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\sticky-notes.json"`
4. Restart dsh web

---

- DeepSeek Harness **web mode** (`dsh web`)
- Browser: modern Chromium / Firefox / Safari
- No third-party runtime dependencies

Thanks to [@scraed](https://github.com/scraed) for the interaction designs proposed in [PR #1](https://github.com/charrywhite/dsh-sticky-notes/pull/1): the home key (tap to hide/show all notes, long-press to create) and tap-the-title-to-collapse.

---

**Q: What is dsh-sticky-notes?**
A: A sticky-notes plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that adds draggable note cards to the `dsh web` UI: text to-dos, image notes, 9 skins, and AI agents can read and write your notes directly.

**Q: How do I install it?**
A: One command, then restart dsh web and hard-refresh the page (Ctrl+F5):

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:charrywhite/dsh-sticky-notes
```

**Q: Does it support image notes?**
A: Yes. Choose "Image note" when creating a note, then click or drag in an image; images are auto-compressed to save storage.

**Q: Can the AI model read and write my notes?**
A: Yes. The plugin registers two model tools — `sticky_notes_read` (list all notes) and `sticky_notes_add` (create a note / append an item). Tell the model "take a look at my notes" or "add a note for me". The AI can only append/create — it cannot modify or delete what you wrote by hand.

**Q: Where is my note data stored? Will it survive a refresh?**
A: Yes. The authoritative copy lives at `~/.dsh/sticky-notes.json` on the harness host; the browser uploads after every change, and refreshes, restarts, and agent writes all stay in sync.

**Q: How do I edit an existing item?**
A: Double-click the item text to enter edit mode; press Enter or click elsewhere to save, Esc to cancel.

**Q: What makes it different from other sticky-note plugins?**
A: It is a floating board of draggable notes rendered in the dsh web UI, with AI agents able to read and write notes (agent tools), plus 9 skins, image notes, and double-click editing. Data is stored authoritatively on the harness host, and agent writes sync back to the browser within seconds.
